definition: why the highest-payback channel still has to be paid for inside the budget

settled:
Repairing the relationship is my highest-payback channel, and it still does not get to spend at or above my line.

Repair is itself an activity with a difficulty level on it. From 2.5 to 3.5, real repair can sit at or above where I am, and that is exactly what the gate refuses.

I try to keep the repair work affordable as well.

So the rule reaches everything, the best channel included. There is no exemption for a high return.

title: No Exemption For My Best Lever
